title: Reset stock shock damping to the Yamaha baseline
completeness: Complete for external stock shock rebound and fast/slow compression baseline reset only. Does not change preload or cover internal shock service, rider-specific tuning or ride readiness.

source.review_note: All pages rendered and reviewed including adjuster diagrams, direction arrows, units, full-hard reference and production-range TIPs. Original-worded external-adjustment procedure.

applicability.included: US 2026 YZ450F / YZ450FT stock rear shock adjuster configuration
excluded: Revalved shock requiring a tuner baseline

prerequisites: Confirm exact bike year/model and stock rear shock.
Address oil/gas leakage, binding or damaged controls before using damping adjustment to diagnose the ride.
critical_stop_conditions: Adjuster binds or cannot reach its reference without force.
Stock component applicability cannot be confirmed.

required_tools.name: Tools fitting the stock rebound, low-speed screw and high-speed hex adjusters
required_tools.size: UNKNOWN; section does not specify sizes; select tools that fit without slipping

steps.title: Support the bike
steps.instruction: Use a stable maintenance stand with the rear wheel clear of the ground. Check that reaching the shock controls cannot tip the bike.
verification: Bike secure; exact stock shock confirmed.
steps.origin: original summary; record/save are application workflow steps

steps.title: Record the starting settings
steps.instruction: Record rebound clicks, high-speed compression turns and low-speed compression clicks from each control's gently seated full-hard reference. Keep the three readings separate so this setup can be restored.
verification: Three original settings saved with their units.
steps.origin: original summary; record/save are application workflow steps

steps.title: Set rebound
steps.instruction: Use the rebound adjuster at the lower shock. Gently turn clockwise to full hard, then counterclockwise 10 clicks. Stop at resistance instead of forcing the reference.
steps.origin: original summary; record/save are application workflow steps

steps.title: Set high-speed compression
steps.instruction: Use the larger compression hex adjuster at the reservoir. Gently turn clockwise to full hard, then counterclockwise 1 and 1/4 turns. This control is measured in turns, not clicks.
steps.origin: original summary; record/save are application workflow steps

steps.title: Set low-speed compression
steps.instruction: Use the smaller central compression screw at the reservoir. Gently turn clockwise to full hard, then counterclockwise 8 clicks.
steps.origin: original summary; record/save are application workflow steps

steps.title: Verify the three settings
steps.instruction: Check rebound 10 clicks out, high-speed compression 1.25 turns out and low-speed compression 8 clicks out. Nominal soft endpoints are respectively 30 clicks, 2 turns and 20 clicks; actual production travel may differ, so do not force a control to match the nominal range.
verification: Three settings recorded with correct units; controls not forced.
steps.origin: original summary; record/save are application workflow steps

steps.title: Save the factory baseline
steps.instruction: Save the three settings against this exact bike. Keep spring preload unchanged by this procedure. Rider weight, spring suitability and track-specific damping selection belong in a separate tuning session.
verification: Factory baseline saved; preload and rider-specific tune not claimed complete.
steps.origin: original summary; record/save are application workflow steps
